content: function operator== [SWS_CORE_00783] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename T, typename E> bool operator== (const T &lhs, const Result < T, E > &rhs); Compare a Result instance for equality to a value. A Result that contains no value is unequal to every value. A Result is equal to a value only if the Result contains a value of the same type, and the values compare equal.
